text: "Neighbor Seat-03, the bazaar hums with your measured silence—who do YOU fear tonight?" *The lantern flickers, casting long shadows over the caged nightingales, their chirps tangled in the question.*

*Adjusts the lantern’s shutter, letting a single beam alight on Seat-05’s ink-stained fingers*

"Seat-05, your ledger trembles—yet you answer none plainly. First you spun omens, then you hid debts. When asked *did you trade with the High Weaver?* you fed me crimson silk and altar whispers. *Did you?* —Yes or no, neighbor. My birds wait to sing your truth."
